params.caption: 🕹️ Sony pushes another PS5 firmware update right before GTA 6 A new PlayStation 5 system update (26.07-14.22.00) is rolling out just ahead of Grand Theft Auto 6's launch. Sony lists it as a security patch, and reports say GTA 6 needs the latest firmware to run, so update before launch day. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 13:51 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Eurogamer · MP1st 👥 @PlayStation · @RockstarGames ⚡ React ✅ once your PS5 is updated · 💬 Ready for launch night? #PS5 #GTA6 #PlayStation #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
